PraisonAIUI ships 81 composable UI component builders plus a built-in Notification Center. Every component returns a plain JSON/YAML dictionary, so you can build rich pages in Python (@aiui.page) or zero-code YAML (pages: in app.yaml), render any block inline inside Agent Chat (await aiui.send_block(...)), embed aiui.chat_panel() beside tables/docs on any page, and register custom React blocks through @aiui/sdk. Every dedicated component page in the sidebar renders the real interactive React component live right above its Python and YAML snippets.
